description: Use this when someone asks what to buy on Vinted to resell at a profit, what's worth flipping, or the best items to resell within a budget (e.g. 'what can I flip on Vinted with 200 euros?', 'which iPhones are worth reselling?'). Ranks models by the gap between what cheaper listings ask and what they sell for, after buyer protection and shipping, weighted by how many sold. Covers the electronics Pouncio reads most (phones, consoles, laptops). Do not use for the price of one named item (use check_resale_price) or for judging a listing link (use check_listing_deal).

budget.description: The most the person wants to spend on one item, in their site's currency, if they said.
budget.title: Budget

category.description: A brand or product family to keep to, if the person named one, e.g. 'iPhone', 'PS5', 'Switch', 'MacBook'.
category.title: Category

site.description: The Vinted site the person uses, as its country code: fr, de, it, es, nl, be, pl, pt, at, lt, cz, sk, hu, ro, se, dk, fi, ie, uk, us. Sets the currency. Use the person's country when they don't say; leave empty when unknown.
site.title: Site

name: find_flips
title: Find models worth flipping
